description:
Fixes **0 patches** in Morphe Manager: version 1.1.0 was missing `classes.dex`. This bundle is rebuilt with the Android patch code and verified before upload.

Includes:
* **My POIs** — named folders under My Places, add from My Places / map popup / coordinates
* **Unlock Premium Subscription**
* **Unlock Truck Profile**

Pinned to TomTom GO / GO Expert 3.6.326 (versionCode 1678737). Refresh the source in Morphe Manager; if 1.1.0 is cached, remove and re-add the source.

patches.name: My POIs
patches.description: Adds a "My POIs" screen to the main menu, under My Places: named folders of saved places, kept separate from My Places. Places can be added from My Places or from any point on the map ("Add to My POIs" button).

patches.name: Unlock Premium Subscription
patches.description: Forces TomTom's subscription checks to report an active paid plan, hides the trial timeline/paywall and removes the free-trial card.

patches.name: Unlock Truck Profile
patches.description: Enables the full truck vehicle profile (dimensions, weight, ADR, etc.) and stops the app from reverting it to a car profile.

repoDescription: Morphe patches for TomTom GO / GO Expert: unlock the subscription, enable the full truck profile, and add My POIs folders.
